parse.title: Guide:Cow's Chill Ironman Guide to Priff+
parse.wikitext:
== Barrows Gloves and Dragon Defender ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 22|
* Make sure you have at least 2.5m GP before Blast Furnace
** Bank for GP, Ring of Charos (a), Goldsmith Gauntlets, Ice Gloves. Buy and smelt 2.2k Gold Ore at Blast Furnace
** Turn all Mithril Ore into Bars and make sure you have 300+ Silver Bars banked
** If you don't have GP, do more Wildy Agility (best) or craft Earth/Air Battlestaves
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Magic_Guild_Store_(Runes_and_Staves) Wizards Guild] and stack up on Runes.  Values below are totals
** 3k Natures
** 400 Law Runes
** 3k Death Runes
** 10k+ Fire Runes
** Mystic Bottoms, Top, and Hat
* Get 40 Slayer from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Nieve Nieve]
** Mostly melee tasks with Ardy Cloak Prayer restore or with food
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Eagles%27_Peak Eagle's Peak]
** Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Slug_Menace Slug Menace] until you have 5 Runestones
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Throne_of_Miscellania Throne of Miscellania]
*** Get 100% favor from Teak Logs
*** Deposit 1.4m in coffer split evenly between Mahoganies and Maple
*** Once you get 3k Maple logs in bank, switch Maples to Herbs
*** Once you get 100 Mahogany Logs in bank, switch back to Teaks
*** Once you have 2300 Teak Logs, swap back to Mahoganies
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Royal_Trouble Royal Trouble]
** Include Pickaxe, Complete the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tarn%27s_Lair Tarn's Lair Miniquest]
*** Kill a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Terror_dog Terror Dog] & mine a Mithril Ore
** Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_Isles Fremennik Isles]
** Make sure to make a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_shield Fremennik Shield] during the quest
* 61 Crafting Crafting & Blowing [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Molten_glass Molten Glass]
** Alternative is Low-Level Earth Orbs
{{Youtube|L4uKH-MgLSM}}
* Bank, withdraw Tinderbox, Bullseye Lantern, Melee Gear, Swordfish, Energy Potions, Prayer Potions, Clean Guam, Clean Marrentill, Pestle and Mortar, Dramen Staff
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lunar_Diplomacy Lunar Diplomacy] and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Slug_Menace Slug Menace] at the same time
** Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lunar_Diplomacy Lunar Diplomacy] until you have to use Dramen Staff on altars to make Lunar Staff
** Minigame tele to GOTR
** Use the Dramen Staff and Slug Menace Runestones on all 4 Elemental Altars in order of Air, Fire, Water, Earth
** Lastly use the 5th Runestone on the Mind Altar
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Slug_Menace Slug Menace]
*** Buy a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Proselyte_armour Proselyte Hauberk and Proselyte Cuisse] after
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lunar_Diplomacy Lunar Diplomacy]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tai_Bwo_Wannai_Trio Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]
*** Drop Trick to get 2 Karambwan Vessels
*** After the quest, make sure to collect the reward from the 3 brothers
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Big_Chompy_Bird_Hunting Big Chompy Bird Hunting]
*** Collect an extra [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chompy_bird_hunting Raw Chompy] for later
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Land_of_the_Goblins Land of the Goblins]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cold_War Cold War]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Making_History Making History]
** [[Between a Rock...]]
* Get 72 Mining, ideally via Sandstone
* Fish to 62 (Barb Fishing, Fly Fishing Salmon, Karambwans, Tempoross)
* Complete Quests
** Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Swan_Song Swan Song]
*** Buy Proselyte Top & Bottom after
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zogre_Flesh_Eaters Zogre Flesh Eaters]
** Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Making_Friends_with_My_Arm Making Friends with My Arm]
*** Mine Salts
**** 100 Stony Basalt
**** 100 Icy Basalt
**** 3700 Urt Salt
**** 3750 Efh Salt
**** 4100 Te Salt
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/What_Lies_Below What Lies Below]
*** Keep the Dragon'hai History Book (5 Kudos)
* Get 67 Smithing with Hybrid Gold/Mith Ore. Keep 40 Coal and buy the rest
{{Youtube|awm87TMN_BY}}
* Smith 1 Mithril 2h Sword, 5 Mithril Grapples, keep 10 of each bar
* Smith the rest of the Mith Bars into Mithril Platelegs until 68, then Platebodies
* Complete all Diaries possible
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Devious_Minds Devious Minds]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Curse_of_the_Empty_Lord Curse of the Empty Lord]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Legends%27_Quest Legends Quest]
* Get 70 Cooking
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mess Mess Hall] in Hosidius, Tempoross, or Fishing
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fremennik_Isles Fremennik Isles]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Defender_of_Varrock Defender of Varrock]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Recipe_for_Disaster Recipe for Disaster]
*** Buy [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barrows_gloves Barrows Gloves]
{{Youtube|_aJkMgdlURE}}
* Obtain a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_defender Dragon Defender]
** Use [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Animated_Mithril_Armour Animated Mithril Armour] for [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Warrior_guild_token Tokens]
** Optionally get a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fighter_torso Fighter Torso] as well
* Complete all Easy and Medium Diaries
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Gout_tuber/Strategies Gout Tuber Strategy]
* Time to get 70 Prayer... Ring of Dueling to Ferox Enclave and run East to the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wilderness_Slayer_Cave Wilderness Slayer Cave]
** Alternative is to do Blue Dragons in the Dragon's Nest
}}
